target_customer: Engineering and IT teams at growing companies that needed centralized logins to servers, VPN and wifi
problem: Small teams struggled to run LDAP and RADIUS servers securely and tie them to their Google or other identity accounts.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for cloud-hosted LDAP and RADIUS

founders.name: Aren Sandersen
founders.background_notes: Team page says about 17 years in software engineering, architecture and IT operations.

technical_complexity.rationale: Running secure, scalable hosted LDAP and RADIUS with integrations to Google Apps and other providers was standard but security-sensitive engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Once servers and wifi were wired to the directory it was sticky, but identity vendors could add LDAP features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Splashtop acquired Foxpass in March 2023 and kept the brand.

market_need_then: Engineering teams growing past a handful of people needed centralized access control for servers and networks while moving to cloud identity providers.

branding.domain_note: Uses foxpass.com; now redirects to a Splashtop page.

identity.logo: Fox-themed logo filed as an image trademark on 2015-07-07

brand_strength.rationale: Trademarks filed in 2015 and the brand kept after acquisition, but no press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Foxpass was a one-founder YC company that sold hosted LDAP and RADIUS to engineering teams such as Lyft, Segment and HackerOne, stayed small at about 10 people, and was acquired by Splashtop on 2023-03-23 with the brand retained. Splashtop later reported a 62 percent rise in new Foxpass business. Modest funding and a steady niche made this a capital-efficient exit.
notes: Seedtable lists about 120K in July 2015 and 1.3M in January 2019, and BankInfoSecurity says 1.3M was raised in January 2019; the 1.3M figure has two outlets but no investor or primary source, so no round recorded. Founder background came from a search summary of the team page (foxpass.com/team), not opened directly. Acquisition blog fetch was redirected and not followed. Competitor search returned only undated vendor comparisons, so the list is empty. Completeness pass: the 2015-07 round (about 120K) rests on Seedtable alone; the 1.3M of 2019-01 is reported by Seedtable and BankInfoSecurity (https://www.bankinfosecurity.com/splashtop-buys-foxpass-to-bring-enterprise-iam-to-masses-a-21497) without investor or primary source. CB Insights states about 1.42M total, which is more than the two recorded rounds. Splashtop announced the acquisition on 2023-03-23 with undisclosed terms.
